summary: The backend keeps the provider:list-catalog cache in <userData>/data/model-catalog.json as well as in memory, so a launch answers from the last probe instead of starting every provider's CLI (over a second each). An entry younger than an hour is answered as before; an older one is answered at once while a probe refreshes it behind the reply. Editing or deleting a provider instance clears the file with the memory cache, and a probe that was running when the cache was cleared does not store its answer. The IPC contract is unchanged.

desktop.reason: The desktop calls provider:list-catalog as before; only the backend answers faster.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone calls the same channel with the same reply shape; it gets the faster answer with no client change.

nativeAndroid.reason: The phone calls the same channel with the same reply shape; it gets the faster answer with no client change.

storageDataMigration.reason: A new cache file, no migration: a missing or unreadable file starts an empty cache, and an older build ignores it.

updateRelease.reason: No packaging, channel or signing change; the file lives in the existing user data directory.

notExercised: A remote headless backend: it uses the same module and its own SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR.
